insight: Evolved from AWS CodeWhisperer, which Amazon rebranded and folded into Amazon Q Developer in April 2024.
name: Amazon Q Developer
tagline: AWS's generative-AI assistant for software development.
description: Amazon Q Developer is AWS's generative-AI coding assistant that supports developers across the software lifecycle. It offers inline code completions, agentic chat, automated code transformation for language and framework upgrades, security scanning, and AWS-aware troubleshooting. It runs in popular IDEs, the command line, and the AWS console, with deep integration into AWS services.

modelSupport.notes: Backed by foundation models on Amazon Bedrock; the underlying models are abstracted from the user.

edge: Tightest AWS integration of any coding assistant — agentic code transformation for Java/.NET upgrades plus AWS-aware help in the console and CLI.
pros: Works in IDEs, CLI, and AWS console
IP indemnity on the Pro tier
cons: Best value inside the AWS ecosystem
